title: Life as a Software Engineer
excerpt: Sharing my experiences working as a software engineer across different companies. From tech stack choices to team collaboration, and balancing work with continuous learning...
content:
## My Journey into Software Engineering

It all started with a curiosity about how websites work. That curiosity led me to learn HTML, then CSS, then JavaScript, and before I knew it, I was building full-stack applications.

## Working at Different Companies

From Praexisio to CGU AI Center, and then to Comboware and Ulink, each company taught me something different. At Praexisio, I learned about product thinking. At the AI Center, I dove deep into research-oriented development.

## Tech Stack Choices

One of the most interesting parts of being a software engineer is choosing the right tools for the job. React, Next.js, Python, Docker — each has its place.

## Balancing Work and Learning

The tech industry moves fast. Staying relevant means continuous learning, but it's also important to maintain a healthy work-life balance. Surfing and snowboarding help me reset and come back to code with fresh eyes.
